purpose: Track source provenance, license checks, and import status for locally hosted Chaos Cartridge games.
policy: Imported means upstream source is actually present locally with required license notices. Ash-Fall original builds are playable reimplementations and must not be labeled upstream imports. Restricted or unverified upstream assets are not copied. License audit entries are scoped to the exact upstream LICENSE file inspected; they do not automatically clear separate artwork, audio, or dependency rights.

imports.notes: Existing local import; retain upstream license and attribution.
